engine: Soundbox 0.4.1 CLI driving audio.cpp v0.9.4 (CPU build, stable_audio family); Soundbox defaults for this model: 8 steps, guidance 1.0; audio.cpp generates 6 s past the asked duration and truncates; 44.1 kHz stereo 16-bit out of audio.cpp
